metadata.description: The name of the Sentinel workspace

properties.description: Detects exploitation attempts targeting CVE-2026-86060: MikroTik RouterOS contains an improper neutralization of argument delimiters in a command vulnerability which allows an attacked to change the trusted RouterOS policy mask, leading to privilege escalation.. Product: RouterOS
properties.query: union CommonSecurityLog, SecurityEvent, AzureDiagnostics | where Message contains "CVE-2026-86060" or Message contains "ROUTEROS" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), clientIp_s | where count_ > 3
